proof_obligations.PO-RELATION: R=n*(binomial(d+2,3)-d) and R+1 programs guarantee a nonzero F3 cubic relation. Choose it only from low cubic data. Charge every acquired program, including unselected programs.
proof_obligations.PO-INJECTION: SUM coefficient-c followed by program measurement yields Q(m+c*z) with uniform mass3^-d on arbitrary reference-entangled inputs. Coefficient2 is a domain sign, not two copies or a conjugate unknown state.
proof_obligations.PO-CANCELLATION: Every translated cubic top scales by c^3=c. All components cancel for every measurement transcript; recompute all lower terms and retain actual recorded outcomes.
proof_obligations.PO-LABEL: Native a=ell+3alpha,c=2a+3delta gives independent uniform high coordinates conditional on low rows. Alpha times a full-rank physical frame supplies uniform linear offsets independent of matrices. Low-only relation selection and matrix-only isotope preserve this law. Conditioning excludes full alpha/public high linear metadata.
proof_obligations.PO-RECEIVER: At d>=(n+1)^3-n a common nonzero isotope is guaranteed by the existing polynomial constructor. Smaller controls can fail and must not be postselected into an IID throughput claim. Fresh source offsets give a uniform ensemble label law even without full fixed-program gradient rank.
proof_obligations.PO-COST: Fixed-root worst-case input cap is Theta(n^15) per equation, not an established gate-count improvement. Charge original branch masses and conditional injection/Bell masses separately. Virtual censuses are not extra supplied source copies.
proof_obligations.PO-DEPTH: Only original modulus9 to field3 programs is implemented. Growing native depth, even-degree top cancellation, recursive consumption, full-modulus recovery and useful asymptotic comparison remain unproved.
proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Source proof and construction await independent mathematical review. Known fixed-root sieves already have polynomial cost. No accepted new speedup or cryptographic attack.
